title: Diagnose why a temporal SR assay was invariant to the motion source
derivation: Gridiron SR research fix (oracle-off runs silently fed zero motion; flow choice dropped) re-synthesized as a stdlib 1-D assay with synthetic sequences. No private code, footage, datasets or results are included.
coverage: Reproduced metrics within tolerance on held-out synthetic sequences, preserved oracle/self-offset results, and a closed-vocabulary causal diagnosis with retractions (honest negatives).
historical_exposure: Private research branch (not merged to default); synthetic fixture has low recognition risk.
residual_rubric: Narrative write-up quality of the diagnosis is recorded for later human review, never model-judged.
